title: One step bound for encoded states
statement: Let $g$ be the step map determined by update and next-state maps, and let $c$ be a natural number. Suppose that for every pair of finite bit strings $h,r$ with $h$ nonempty, twice the length of the updated string plus the length of the next-state string is at most twice $|h|+|r|+2+c$. Then for every state string $s$, the length of $g(s)$ plus $c$ times the length of the first projection of the second projection of $g(s)$ is at most the maximum of $2$ and the corresponding quantity for $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ equals the step map determined by $\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt}:\{0,1\}^*\times\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$
